validity.recommendation: Hold specs and treat existence as unconfirmed. The row's own citations do not name this pipeline and no independent source could be found. Flag for human review: either locate a primary Aramco/trade source that names an Abqaiq->Berri gas line, or treat P1906 as an unverified bulk-import artifact of the 2022-07-19 Saudi gas cluster.
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE CONCERN. The gem.wiki page's ONLY outbound citations are two OPEC Annual Statistical Bulletins (ASB 2012 p.75; ASB 2017 p.136). url_verifier: ASB2012.pdf returns 200 but does NOT contain 'Abqaiq' or 'Berri'; ASB2017 returns HTTP 403. OPEC ASB is a country-level statistical bulletin (refining/aggregate throughput), not a named-pipeline inventory, and neither document names an 'Abqaiq-Berri gas pipeline' or its 137 km / 24,36-inch specs. So the sheet's own sourcing is a generic citation that does not name this pipeline -- itself an existence flag. Independent web search (EN + Arabic: 'أنبوب غاز بقيق بري') returned NO source naming this line; every hit for the specs traces back to GEM (the search engine's spec restatement is lifted verbatim from gem.wiki). GulfPub PE World Map -- GulfPub's best-covered country (20 SA gas features) -- has NO Abqaiq->Berri gas line; it carries separate short lines 'Abqaiq - Qatif' (14 km, 16 in) and 'Qatif - Berri Pipeline' (32 km, 29 in), whose chain (~46 km) is nothing like GEM's 137 km, and GEM's P1916 (Qatif North-Berri, 45 km/32 in) already independently covers the Qatif->Berri leg. So an independent good-coverage dataset does not corroborate this entity. Not a clean duplicate of another GEM PID (no roster row matches 137 km Abqaiq->Berri), so the concern is existence/notability, not duplication. NB the whole P1897-P1925 Saudi gas cluster shares an updated=2022-07-19 stamp and kilometer-post/facility-code names (UBTG-1-km56, AY-1 KP916, km199) that read like a single engineering/GIS segment extract rather than independently sourced pipelines. Geometrically a 137 km routed Abqaiq->Berri corridor is plausible (straight-line ~115 km), so I do not assert the pipe is fictional -- only that NO independent evidence confirms it exists with the stated name/specs. CLASSIFICATION: cannot be confirmed as a gas transmission trunk vs an associated-gas gathering line into Berri gas plant without a source. SPEC (137 km; 24,36 in; owner Saudi Aramco; status operating; capacity blank): none independently corroborated -- owner=Saudi Aramco is the only value that is safely true on general grounds (all SA gas trunks are Aramco) but even that has no source naming this line.

routes.start_name: Abqaiq (Buqayq) processing complex, Eastern Province, Saudi Arabia
routes.end_name: Berri Gas Plant (near Jubail), Eastern Province, Saudi Arabia
routes.corridor_desc: IF the line exists as named, it would run north/northwest through the Eastern Province oil-and-gas field belt from the Abqaiq/Buqayq hub (~25.94N, 49.68E) up the coastal corridor via the Qatif field area toward the Berri Gas Plant near Jubail (~26.98N, 49.62E). Straight-line separation is ~115 km, consistent with a routed 137 km. Bound is LOOSE: endpoints are well-known Aramco facilities so their approximate centroids are defensible, but I found NO independent source describing the actual corridor, and the pipeline's existence itself is unconfirmed (see validity). Coordinates are approximate facility centroids, not a surveyed alignment; intermediate waypoints are not sourced and were left empty rather than invented.
routes.researcher_notes: Endpoints inferred from the pipeline NAME (Abqaiq -> Berri) plus the known locations of the Abqaiq processing complex and the Berri Gas Plant near Jubail -- both real, well-known Aramco Eastern Province facilities, so approximate lat/lon are defensible, not fabricated. No independent source names or traces this specific pipeline's route; corridor is offered only as a loose bound for a possible future human routes-repo branch and must not be applied while existence is unconfirmed. No coordinates were invented; waypoints left null for lack of a source.

summary: P1906 Abqaiq-Berri Gas Pipeline: EXISTENCE concern -- only citations are two OPEC ASBs that don't name it (ASB2012 verified lacking terms, ASB2017 403), no independent source found EN/AR, GulfPub (best SA coverage) lacks it; specs (137km/24,36in) uncorroborated; loose Abqaiq->Berri corridor suggested at route accuracy low.
